d: Enjoy this Classic Romantic Hindi song Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se sung by Hemlata and Music composed by Ravindra Jain from Rajshri Production's super hit film Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se (1978) starring Sachin Pilgaonkar & Ranjeeta Kaur and Directed by Hiren Nag! This Evergreen classic song remains popular even today!
